text_block_list.text:
Stand up straight and pull your chin in.
Good. I'll
measure your height now.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to ask for a physical exam so
suddenly. I
just wanted to make sure my
application is filled
out accurately.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. There, all
done.
You're 171 centimeters. Oh,
you've gotten taller.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text:
I guess you must still be growing. I'll
forward the
information on.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll take my leave no—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... No, nothing's wrong. This smell
just
brings back some memories.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(I remember lying in a hospital bed then,
trying to
come up with a single
equation...)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: (A winning equation to beat her.)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Okay! I'm gonna pick up the pace, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
Wow, really?! Me too, me too! I'm not
gonna lose
to you!
text_block_list.name: Young Brian

text_block_list.text:
(I wonder, when was the last time I was
ahead of
her?)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Doctor? May I borrow Kinematics in Sports next? I want to get faster.
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
Now's not the time to think about that.
You need
to rest. You do want to
recover quickly, don't
you?
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I think now's the best time to
do a lot of
thinking.
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I panicked because I was
about to
lose... and that's how I got
injured.
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to come up with a
winning
equation.
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text: (So I don't lose again...)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your help. I should go
now.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! All of the staff at the
academy
are here to support you
students.
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut. Keep it up!
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text: Thank you. I will.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
When I greet Бива Хаяхидэ after her
health
exam, I'm glad to see her looking
refreshed and
free of worries.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two of us are going to tackle the
Twinkle
Series starting today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Now that the date of my debut
race has
been decided, we know what
we need to do.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Train hard, formulate a path to victory,
and go
into the race with a solid
strategy. The results will
follow.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
First, let's start by checking my times to
assess
where I currently am.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ is at the other end of the
track in
a flash.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We decide to measure her time after
each
furlong, or 200-meter interval. I
look at my
stopwatch to check.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's a pretty fast lap. I wouldn't
expect any less
from Нарита Брайан's big
sister.
text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't look so surprised. We're just
here to
scope out the so-called "number
one contender"
around here.
text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
She didn't get that title for nothing. Her
run was a
sight to see in the scrimmage I
saw the other day!
text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, a group of other
trainers have
gathered around to watch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We're all trainers here, right? We need
to see how
you carry out your training
sessions!
text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
I must say, I was surprised when I heard
Brian was
going to debut before her
older sister. But I
guess—
text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer C

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'm glad everyone's having
such a
good time, but I need to have a
word with my
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'm glad everyone's having
such a
good time, but I need to have a
word with my
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Well, well... Aren't you popular?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: I'm not the one who's popular. It's you!

text_block_list.text:
I tell Бива Хаяхидэ what the other
trainers were
saying about her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So I'm considered the number one

contender, huh?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Well, that's very flattering, but I can't
accept such
a mantle as things are at the
moment.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The reason they took an interest in me
to begin
with is because I'm Narita
Brian's sister.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm no more than above average
at the
moment, and I'm not satisfied with
that.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I don't simply want to be above average.
I want
to become the strongest racer
here.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Her steely gaze seems fixed in her
mind's eye on
somewhere—or
someone—as she says this.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I wonder... What result will the final
computation
of my equation bring? I
wonder if victory exists
on the list of
potential answers.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Pfft... hahaha! I nearly forgot the type of
person
you are. Of course you'd say that.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll need all the help you can give
me. Let's
complete the winning
equation... together.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And that's how my journey with Biwa
Hayahide
begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
